Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

#ifndef ALEF_TEST_SKIP
#define ALEF_TEST_SKIP(reason) do { \
    fprintf(stderr, "skipped: %s\n", (reason)); \
    return EXIT_SUCCESS; \
} while (0)
#endif

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY");
    if (getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY") == NULL) { ALEF_TEST_SKIP("GEMINI_API_KEY not set"); }
    LITERLLMAlefHandle chat_completion_request_handle = literllm_chat_completion_request_from_json("{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite\"}");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_chat(client, chat_completion_request_handle);
    literllm_chat_completion_response_free(result);
    literllm_chat_completion_request_free(chat_completion_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
